sections.name: summary
sections.value: Context brief. New pure module crates/daemon/src/community/templates.rs: a Catalog of (name, version, bytes), shipped() embeds every templates/roles/<name>/v<n>/role.dd.json with include_bytes! (as layout.rs does for schemas); tests inject fixture catalogs through DirectoryService::with_templates, so new() call sites are unchanged. http/directory.rs: add takes --from template:<name>[@v<n>] (template document, meta.id set, flags override through role::apply_fields) or --from file:<brief> (= --brief); new leaves templates and template-diff <id>. community/directory.rs view: per-role template drift and the C22/C26 prompts. pij_core::directory help gains the new verbs; the CLI renders templates, template-diff and prompts. The shim forwards directory argv unchanged, so no TS. Tests: role.rs and templates.rs units; crates/daemon/tests/directory_http.rs over HTTP with scratch repos, FakeDdocs, plus a real-ddocs case that skips when ddocs is absent. Hazards: shared seams with other lanes (directory.rs, cli main.rs, skills/pij) kept minimal; own target with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 and -p.

value.title: Template catalog: embed every templates/roles version, list, load, diff in-process
value.success: community/templates.rs holds every templates/roles/<name>/v<n>/role.dd.json as include_bytes!, a test fails on any file not embedded, and a line diff runs in-process.

value.title: directory add --from template:<name>[@v<n>] and --from file:<brief>; directory templates
value.success: add copies the named version through the writer with meta.id set and template/template_version recorded, flags override fields; file: is --brief; unknown name or version refuses by name listing what exists; templates lists names and versions.

value.title: Drift in the view and directory template-diff <id>
value.success: the view marks a role whose template version is behind the latest; template-diff prints T@vn to T@vm; nothing is applied and the role file is byte-identical.

value.title: Core-role and security prompts in the view, PEC wording
value.success: the view lists each missing core role with a runnable --from template line and a security prompt until a security role exists, in the PEC wording; nothing is created.

value.title: Docs and states: README to PEC, API doc, skill coverage, community procedure, req-14 reworded, flips
value.success: templates README in PEC wording; pij-rs-api.md and skill table carry --from, templates and template-diff; community README says templates are examples; req-14 reworded with a C22 changelog row; s03 complete, req-13/14 shipped, req-27 and c-templates in-progress; just ddocs-check clean.

value.title: Cost proof on a private daemon and the PR gates
value.success: spawn-counter deltas around templates, template-diff and one add --from template recorded in assets/evidence/phase-2.md; scoped rust-check, biome, local-path-check, lockfile-allowlist and ddocs-check pass.

tk-0001.assertion: The embedding test walks templates/roles/ and fails when a role.dd.json there is not in the catalog; the catalog bytes equal the files.
The diff of two template versions is computed in-process and launches nothing.

tk-0002.assertion: In a scratch governance repo, add --from template:<name> for each of the six templates commits a role with meta.id set and template and template_version recorded, and real ddocs validates it when installed.
An unknown template or version refuses with E-RS-ARG naming it and listing what exists; nothing is committed.
A flag given with --from template overrides that field; --from file:<brief> writes the same document as --brief <brief>.

tk-0003.assertion: With a v1 and a v2 fixture template, a role from v1 with a local edit shows drift in the view, template-diff prints the v1 to v2 change, and the role file is byte-identical afterwards.
A role from the latest version, or from no template, shows no drift.

tk-0004.assertion: An empty directory view lists five core-role prompts and a security prompt, each with a runnable pij directory add line, and the PEC guidance; nothing is written.
After adding security (or a role from the security template) its prompt is gone; a role made from a core template clears that core prompt.

tk-0005.assertion: just ddocs-check is clean and ddocs validate reports 0 errors and 0 warnings on PRD 001, the roadmap and the blueprint with req-14 reworded and the state flips.
The skill verb coverage tests pass with templates and template-diff in the directory row.

tk-0006.assertion: On a private daemon the spawn counter moves 0 around directory templates and template-diff, and only by the writer's usual launches around one add --from template.
